method: 32 leave-one-training-pair-out folds, 16 source tasks, same stage and challenge; run sequentially with generic prior on vs empty
runtime_note: Sequential runs had different background load; this is not evidence of speed change.
limitations: Only the generic train-derived prior was ablated; fixed template memory and other HDS mechanisms remained enabled.
32 folds are not the v7 full A/B/C/D experimental contract.
No prior support observations or output effect were observed; cross-task learning improvement is not demonstrated.
Selection and prior origins do not establish unseen benchmark independence.
